description:
Every EPA Superfund National Priorities List (NPL) site in one state (50 states and DC), free: counts (final,
        proposed, deleted, construction complete), a per-county breakdown, the state's rank, plus other EPA record counts
        for the state (other Superfund/SEMS sites, leaking and registered underground storage tanks, brownfields, radon
        zones). Data is EPA's, refreshed nightly; `measured` gives each source's date.

        `state`: two-letter code or name. Optional filters: `county` (e.g. "Middlesex"), `status` ('final', 'proposed'
        or 'deleted'). `limit` caps the site rows returned (1 to 500; counts always cover every site).
name: superfund_sites_by_state
